Stability is mainly influencedby the long-term stability of the coating layers due to potential diffusion processes, in particular, when the layers are not denseenough. The availability of the coating technology for infrared coatings is limited and requires further developments to meet the needs for future Earth-Observation missions working in the Mid-to-Long-Wave and Thermal InfraRed regions. The activity will focus on the development of infrared bandpass and narrowband filters and, in particular, on the associated coating technology to be able to produce reproducible and stable filters with high spectral accuracy (90%). Particular aspects of coating delamination, imperfections and degradation would be assessed carefully, accounting for relevant environmental conditions (e.g. vacuum, thermal, radiations).
